propositions: Zizmor static analysis is scoped to release.yml only and does not audit the vote-casting workflows gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml, leaving their action-composition risks unaudited despite being critical-path for Verified voting.

The SHA-pin assertion in gerrit-verify.yaml:21 is partially false: actions/checkout@v7 and actions/setup-python@v7 use mutable tags instead of pinned SHAs across both gerrit-verify.yaml and _build-and-test.yml, creating a false-claim security vulnerability.
Distribution metadata validation via `twine check dist/*` runs only at release time, not pre-merge, allowing packaging-metadata defects to escape pre-commit gates and only be caught at publish.
Coverage enforcement uses a 70% global floor rather than diff-coverage on changed lines, failing to adopt the OSS-aligned practice of validating incremental coverage without forcing low-value tests.

CodeQL gating decision: should CodeQL move from scheduled-only to vote-casting on the Gerrit Verified gate, trading real per-patchset latency minutes for per-change SAST value that the scheduled sweep already provides.
